hook_text: I'm the Market Queen. Watch me turn a R100 million injection into a R400 million boom.
clip_script:
[0:00-0:05] Hook: I'm the Market Queen. Watch me turn a R100 million injection into a R400 million boom.
[0:05-0:15] Ms Mahlangu points at the board: We do not guess; we calculate. The multiplier effect means an initial injection creates successive rounds of spending.
[0:15-0:30] Animation shows the formula k = 1 / (1 - MPC). Ms Mahlangu: If the Marginal Propensity to Consume is 0,75, your formula is 1 divided by open bracket 1 minus 0,75 close bracket.
[0:30-0:45] The calculation simplifies to 1 / 0,25. Ms Mahlangu: That gives us a multiplier of 4. For every extra Rand, National Income increases by 4.
[0:45-0:55] R100m * 4 = R400m appears on screen. Ms Mahlangu: R100 million injected, R400 million generated. Precision, logic, and structure.
[0:55-1:00] Call to action: Master this to secure your marks.
visual_style: Fast-paced whiteboard animation with crisp, formal text and high-contrast colours.
call_to_action: Master this to secure your marks.
